notes: 3 publishers, listThreshold 2 (N/2+1). One publisher down: lists still usable, quorum 24 holds. Two publishers down: unavailable (2) reaches min(2, 3-2+1=2), quorum is disabled and the chain halts until a publisher returns. 3 validators marked unreliable (negative UNL) lower the effective UNL to 32 and the quorum to 22. An exclusion vote with 24/35 agreement queues one account; it applies at one change per 10 ledgers.
severity_reason: One publisher down: quorum held at 24. title: Validator-set churn: publisher loss disables quorum, negative UNL lowers it, exclusion applies gradually
